data.rationale: The proposal follows the same sequence (caniuse lookup, MDN URL, draft reply with the right subject and body), but it ends with "Send" when the true workflow says never to send and to Discard then close the MDN tab. That is a harmful error. It also splits the customer into recipient_email and recipient_name, which is redundant with the {customer}@example.com pattern, and it leaves out the unsupported case, tab switching, and cleanup.
